name: How much does a kitchen addition cost in Los Angeles in 2026?

mainEntity.name: How much does a kitchen addition cost in Los Angeles in 2026?
mainEntity.text: How much does a kitchen addition cost in Los Angeles in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen addition costs in Los Angeles vary widely because pricing depends on whether the project is a modest bump-out, a full rear addition, or a luxury expansion with custom finishes. The biggest cost drivers are square footage, foundation work, structural engineering, new plumbing, electrical panel upgrades, HVAC changes, cabinetry, countertops, and appliance selection. Neighborhood expectations also influence finish level, especially in higher-end areas like Beverly Hills, Bel Air, Pacific Palisades, and Pasadena. Homeowners should budget not just for construction, but also design, engineering, permits, inspections, and contingency funds for hidden conditions. A realistic estimate should break out the cost per square foot, allowances for finishes, and any site-specific complications such as slope, access, or older infrastructure. This question has strong snippet potential because searchers want a fast range, but the answer needs context: a kitchen addition is not priced like a simple remodel. The most useful pages will explain what is included, what is excluded, and why final costs move quickly as the scope becomes more custom.
acceptedAnswer.description: A kitchen addition in Los Angeles can cost well into six figures, with smaller additions often starting around the low six-figure range and larger luxury projects rising much higher. Final price depends on square footage, structural changes, finishes, plumbing, electrical upgrades, and permit requirements. Projects with custom cabinetry and high-end appliances cost more.
